subject.title: feat(talk): describe_view inline vision for OpenAI Realtime + Gemini Live

question: Should OpenClaw accept browser-direct `describe_view` Video Talk now, and if so must camera permission be scoped to Control UI-only before merge?
rationale: The PR creates a new camera and browser-to-provider image boundary, and automation cannot decide the permanent security/product boundary for that capability.

options.title: Narrow And Prove The MVP
options.body: Require Control UI-only camera permission, consistent provider denial behavior, rebase to current UI paths, and redacted real browser/provider proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Global Same-Origin Camera Access
options.body: Maintainers could approve the broader `camera=(self)` default only after explicitly deciding every same-origin Gateway response may be camera-capable.

options.title: Pause For Transport Design
options.body: Pause this browser-direct PR until the broader provider/gateway video-frame design at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89131 is resolved.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Prove The MVP
recommendation.body: Require Control UI-only camera permission, consistent provider denial behavior, rebase to current UI paths, and redacted real browser/provider proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to steipete as the main browser Realtime Talk owner and a recent Talk settings contributor.
